name: Walking Corpse
description: You raise a humanoid corpse into a grunt-tier undead creature by placing two malachite in the eye sockets. Choose a Skeletal Thrall, Risen Thrall, or Ghoul Thrall based on the condition of the corpse. The undead retains any equipment the corpse was wearing. This effect is permanent with the target being in a constant maddened state unless controlled by the Command Undead action.
charge: You can raise the corpse as a standard-tier undead instead (Skeleton Warrior, Risen, or Ghoul).
